_doc: Opening build orders. Steps run in order; a step is done when the team OWNS (finished or under construction / queued) at least `count` of it. `build` = structure, `unit` = vehicle. A value starting with @ is a role resolved from stats.json for the AI's race (src/ai/AiData.js ROLES: @power @supply @crew @parts @assembly @vehicles @research @storage @tower @wallPost @turret @harvester @builder @combatVehicle), otherwise a stats.json id. AI v4 (docs/notes/ai-v4.md): normal and hard build the vehicle factory second and want their trucks right after it – trucks are the only income that grows, everything later waited for them. A step whose role has no buildable candidate for the race (e.g. @supply for a race with population.fullFromStart) is skipped. `races` may override a whole list per race key: { "X": { "normal": [...] } } – none needed today. D3 (docs/notes/d3-ai-economy.md): the match starts with 10 % energy (the vehicle factory alone costs more), so every order opens with 2 power plants and adds a 3rd after the trucks; further plants come from the energy plan (difficulty.power: a consumer the plants do not cover gets a power plant first), the @power steps are only a floor.
